# KYCStep

Figma: [08m. KYCStep](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-965) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

Safqah’s KYC verification UI - a step screen (progress + form) and a checklist hub. Built atoms→molecules→organism entirely from existing DS components; the only new part is the KYCTaskRow molecule. RTL primary, LTR mirrored.

### KYCTaskRow

One verification task: step indicator, task name with hint, and StatusPill (Verified, Action needed, Waiting).

Level: molecule · Contains: StepIndicator, Content, StatusPill · Part of: KYCChecklist

Use when:
- Rows of KYCChecklist
- State=Current for the task blocking the investor

Don't use when:
- For generic list rows use ListItem

Accessibility: Status is text in the pill, not only colour.

### KYCChecklist

Verification hub «أكمل توثيق حسابك» with progress line and a KYCTaskRow per requirement (ID via Nafath, documents, bank account, final review).

Level: organism · Contains: KYCTaskRow

Use when:
- Verification hub showing done vs remaining KYC tasks
- Surfacing the blocking task (Action needed) so users jump straight to it

Don't use when:
- For a single step screen use KYCStep

Accessibility: List semantics; blocking rows reachable first.

Compliance: Explain why bank name must match ID (payouts are held otherwise).

### KYCStep

One KYC screen: Stepper (Identity, Documents, Bank, Review), section title, the step input (IBAN), inline name-match Alert, Back and Continue.

Level: organism · Contains: Stepper, Section, Input, Alert, Button

Use when:
- Each step of KYC onboarding
- Bank step with IBAN name-match warning before submit

Don't use when:
- For the overview use KYCChecklist

Accessibility: Stepper exposes current step; Alert announced before submit.

Compliance: KYC is a regulatory requirement; explain data use plainly.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

KYCStep covers the two shapes KYC needs: a per-step Screen (Identity → Documents → Bank → Review) that walks the user through verification, and a Checklist hub that shows what’s done and what’s left.

It is a composition, not new primitives - the Stepper, Section, Input, Alert, Button, Content, StatusPill and StepIndicator are all reused unchanged.

### Atomic architecture

### Atoms - reused from the DS

- StepIndicator / StepConnector (06h) - the progress dots + lines.
- Content (07e) - title + description block.
- StatusPill (04e), Section (07h), Input (03a), Alert (05a), Button (02a).

### Molecule - the one new part

- KYCTaskRow - StepIndicator + Content + StatusPill in one row (the DS has no row with a status pill).

### Organisms

- KYCStep - the step screen: Stepper + Section + Input + Alert + Back/Continue.
- KYCChecklist - the hub: a stack of KYCTaskRows with a header.

> **Info:** Nothing here rebuilds an existing component - KYCTaskRow is the only new node, everything else is an instance.

### Molecule - KYCTaskRow

One task’s status: a StepIndicator (done/current/upcoming), the task name + hint, and a StatusPill. State drives all three.

### Organism - KYCChecklist

The verification hub - a header + a KYCTaskRow per requirement, with dividers. Shows overall progress at a glance.

### Organism - KYCStep (screen)

One step of the flow: the Stepper for progress, a Section title, the step’s input (here the IBAN), an inline Alert for the name-match rule, and Back / Continue.

### Direction - LTR and RTL

RTL (Arabic) is primary; the Stepper, rows, and buttons all mirror. Each nested DS component switches to its own RTL variant.

LTR - English

RTL - العربية

### Code examples

```typescript
<KYCStep dir="rtl" current="bank"
  steps={["identity","documents","bank","review"]}>
  <IBANInput onChange={setIban} />
  <Alert tone="warning">الاسم يجب أن يطابق هويتك</Alert>
</KYCStep>

<KYCChecklist dir="rtl" items={tasks} />  // tasks: {title,status}[]
```

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

One step per screen with the Stepper always visible - the user always knows where they are and what’s next.

Do

Give a checklist hub that surfaces what’s blocking (“Action needed”) so users can jump straight to it.

Don’t

Don’t leave every step “upcoming” - reflect real progress (completed / current) or users can’t tell they’ve advanced.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Info:** KYCStep is a composition - the only new node is the KYCTaskRow molecule. Everything else is a live DS instance; fix bugs upstream, not here.

> **Tip:** The name-match Alert reflects the real IBAN-mismatch pain point - keep it inline, before submit.

> **Warning:** Arabic renders in Tajawal (IBM Plex Sans Arabic won’t load in-plugin). Re-font to the DS Arabic before publishing; Stepper digits are font-neutral.
